stories.message: Opened https://harbor-street-pizza.immensus-staging.app/preview/ anonymously. All menu items shown grouped by category (Drinks, Pizzas, Sides) with name, description and price (e.g. Margherita £9.50, Pepperoni £11.50). GET MenuApi returned 200.
evidence: page text listing all items with prices

stories.message: On /checkout, toggled Pickup/Delivery. Pickup shows only Name/Phone fields. Delivery shows Delivery address + Postcode fields plus Name/Phone, adds a £4.00 delivery fee to total, and an invalid postcode (AB1 2CD) was refused client-side with 'We don't deliver to that postcode' and a 'Switch to pickup instead' link, matching the postcode-list rule.
evidence: checkout page text toggled between Pickup and Delivery showing different field sets
postcode rejection message observed for unlisted postcode

stories.message: No Stripe key is configured on this deployment yet (expected per spec — 'until that key is in place, checkout places the order with paymentStatus: pay_at_store'). Placing a pickup order (name 'QA Tester', phone 07700900000) went straight to order confirmation with Payment: 'Pay at store' and no redirect to a Stripe Checkout Session — confirming no payment sheet is reachable to test against. This is a real third-party (Stripe) integration not yet configured, so the 'pay before order is placed' behaviour cannot be exercised; it is not a defect given the documented fallback.
evidence: POST /preview/CheckoutApi/order 201 returned paymentStatus effectively pay_at_store (confirmation page showed 'Payment: Pay at store')

stories.message: After placing a pay_at_store order (no Stripe key configured, so no payment step to go through), the confirmation screen at /order/:code showed order number, status (Received), payment state (Pay at store), fulfilment (Pickup), estimated ready time (7:33 PM), items and total. Matches acceptance for the confirmation screen itself; the 'after paying' precondition could not be exercised because Stripe isn't configured yet (see pay-online).
evidence: GET /preview/OrderConfirmationApi/75US8lu0QvRdruvhTC_gaImiNoJtLl_A 200 with summary and estimated ready time rendered

stories.message: Signed in as admin (owner@example.com) and opened /manage/orders, which listed existing orders via GET OrderAdminApi?queue=active. Without reloading the admin page, placed a new anonymous pickup order ('Live Stream Check') on a separate page. The admin page's own background polling (repeated GET OrderAdminApi?queue=active calls observed in the network log) picked up the new order #uPbqwweo at the top of the list with items (Cola x1), fulfilment (Pickup) and payment status (Pay at store) shown, with no manual reload.
evidence: new order #uPbqwweo appeared in queue text after being placed from a different page

stories.message: Signed in as admin (owner@example.com), opened /manage/menu, clicked Edit on 'Cola', changed price to £2.10 and Save: page showed 'Bad Request' and network showed PATCH /preview/MenuAdminApi/menu-cola 400 — price unchanged in the list. Retried changing only the description with the same result (PATCH 400 again). The owner cannot save any menu item edit. (For contrast, StoreSettingsApi PUT with an edited field succeeded with 200, so this is specific to MenuAdminApi, not a general auth problem.)
evidence: page text shows 'Bad Request' banner and menu list price unchanged (£2.00) after attempted save

stories.message: Signed in as admin (owner@example.com), on /manage/orders. Clicking 'Mark preparing' on any Received order returns a 'Bad Request' banner on the page and the underlying call fails: PUT /preview/OrderAdminApi/<id> 400. Reproduced on three different orders (ids c548b224-d5c1-4566-81d7-be61efcc10fd and order-0002) for 'Mark preparing', 'Mark ready' and 'Cancel order' actions — every status-changing PUT to OrderAdminApi returned 400 and no order's status changed on reload. The owner cannot currently advance or cancel any order.
evidence: page text shows 'Bad Request' banner and statuses unchanged after each attempt

defects.message: Every PATCH to MenuAdminApi (menu item edits) returns 400 Bad Request regardless of which field changes (price or description), on the live /preview deployment. Blocks the owner from editing any menu item.

Every status-changing PUT to OrderAdminApi (Mark preparing, Mark ready, Cancel order) returns 400 Bad Request on the live /preview deployment across multiple distinct orders. Blocks the owner from advancing or cancelling any order.

notes: Walked all 7 founder stories on the live /preview deployment of Harbor Street Pizza. Anonymous customer flow (menu browse, basket, pickup/delivery toggle with postcode-list enforcement, checkout, confirmation) all worked correctly via functional probes. No Stripe key is configured yet, so checkout correctly falls back to pay_at_store per the documented spec — pay-online is not_testable for that reason, not a defect. Signed in as admin with the given password account and found two blocking backend defects: MenuAdminApi PATCH and OrderAdminApi PUT both return 400 Bad Request on every write attempt, while StoreSettingsApi PUT succeeds normally — so this is isolated to those two resources' write paths, not a general auth or session issue. Cross-cutting anonymousAccess and roleEscalation probes both passed clean (403 with code auth_required/admin_required, no browser auth dialogs) against MenuAdminApi, StoreSettingsApi and OrderAdminApi for both anonymous requests and signed-in non-admin member accounts (member, member2). authScope is left to the platform's own measurement as instructed.

accessTest.reason: the plan makes no resource owner-scoped
